This course now lives under the AI and Machine Learning module:

## [AI for Causal Inference](../03-ai-machine-learning/ai-for-causal-inference/)

The course covers local LLM setup, structured outputs, RAG, literature synthesis, DAG critique, diagnostics, sensitivity workflows, causal report generation, agents, and evaluation for AI-assisted causal work.
